# RESTful APIs or resources for taxonomic module databases

- [BugSigDB](https://waldronlab.io/bugsigdbr/articles/bugsigdbr.html)
  (bugsigdbr)

## Health & Disease
- [GMRepoV2](https://github.com/evolgeniusteam/GMrepoProgrammableAccess/blob/master/programmable-access/R.md)
  (programmable access)
- [mBodyMap](https://github.com/whchenlab/mBodymap/blob/main/programmable-access/R.md)
  (programmable access)
  
## Gut Microbe-Microbial Metabolite
- [gutMGene](https://bio-computing.hrbmu.edu.cn/gutmgene/#/Resource)

- [MiMeDB](https://mimedb.org/downloads) (pathways)
